subject: Proposed Medford Arts Center
overview: Host Michael Marks interviewed Medford Arts Council Chair Gary Roberts and community organizer Jim Silva regarding efforts to establish a dedicated arts center in Medford. The discussion focused on potential locations like the Hegner Center, preliminary survey results showing broad public support, and plans for a feasibility study.

items.title: Guest Introductions and Organizational Background
items.summary: Host Michael Marks introduced Medford Arts Council Chair Gary Roberts and community organizer Jim Silva, who discussed local cultural grantmaking, neighborhood advocacy, and the Green Line Extension project.

items.title: Proposal for a Medford Arts Center
items.summary: The panel discussed the formation of Arts Collaborative Medford and highlighted the former Hegner Center at 15 Maple Park Ave as a primary candidate for a multi-purpose municipal arts facility.

items.title: Funding, Feasibility, and Next Steps
items.summary: The guests outlined plans to research funding models, pursue a professional feasibility study, and gather community input through online surveys and a project website.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Host Michael Marks summarized the civic and economic benefits of supporting local arts organizations before concluding the broadcast.
